# Zed Mermaid renderer

This directory vendors `crates/mermaid_render` from the Zed repository.

- Upstream: <https://github.com/zed-industries/zed>
- Commit: `1d217ee39d381ac101b7cf49d3d22451ac1093fe`
- License: GPL-3.0-or-later

The manifest is adapted to build outside the Zed workspace and to use
Cditor's `gpui-pre` version. The renderer source remains derived from Zed.
